title: The Latest Crier for Apr 20, 2026
items:
Pick up your cash from Cash CAB

If you haven't yet picked up your cash from Cash CAB on Hoo-Rah Day, stop by and pick it up from the Student Development Office! You have until Friday, April 24 at 4:30 p.m. to pick it up! 
Questions? Contact Allyson Mann at manna@central.edu

VOTE NOW FOR NEW SENATORS! (Closes 4/24 at 5pm)

Who Should Represent the Student Body 2026-27? 
Choose with your vote! How? 

1. Open Blackboard 

2. Go to Organizations 

3. Select "Student Senate Elections 26-27" 

4. Read through Candidate Profiles! 

5. VOTE for all whom you approve to represent you!

SI Karaoke Event in Fred’s

Bring your favorite songs to Fred's for a fun night of Karaoke from 7-9pm on Sunday, April 26! Enjoy $13 LARGE PIZZAS using Guilders or cash! PLUS 4 LUCKY performers will walk away with a FREE PIZZA!
